**Texere 0.4.16** · 13 November 2026

- **Citing from Zotero, you choose:** after you pick a Zotero reference with @, if it has a PDF you choose **Reference only** (Enter) or **Reference and PDF**, with its highlights and annotations from Zotero. Without a PDF, only the reference comes in.
- **The pointer in a PDF** (or H) now lets you select text to follow where you're reading, without copying anything into the note; H again brings back your colour.
- **Highlights reach the note faster**, especially in large PDFs.
- **New versions show up sooner** on Texere's home page.

Also in this version (from 0.4.15): @ citations from Zotero without Better BibTeX; help for the "Better BibTeX" message; the bibliography right after the text; no more "Article 1".

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
